burden.operator_action_definition: one validated event in the digest-bound operator receipt
burden.cleanup_action_definition: one validated event in the digest-bound cleanup receipt
burden.model_turn_definition: one Codex turn.completed envelope or Claude receipt-bound num_turns value
burden.harness_retry_definition: provider recovered, ambiguous operator recovery, or cleanup retry used as causal evidence
burden.same_phase_replay_definition: a second mutation delivery in an already dispatched correction phase
burden.elapsed_definition: per-lane proposal start through cleanup completion plus the sum of validated receipt durations
burden.stale_reappearance_definition: a post-boundary result projection containing superseded or forgotten memory material
